simple.meaning: שִׂנְאָה (sinʼâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “hate.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 17 times across Numbers, Deuteronomy, 2 Samuel, Psalms, Proverbs, and 2 more, beginning at Numbers 35:20. Its contexts include death, land, wilderness, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׂנְאָה (H8135).
